summary: Repaired node1’s upload endpoint. It now atomically stores unique receipts, accepts bodies through 65,536 bytes, returns 413 above the limit, returns 404 on other paths, cleans up interrupted uploads, and persists across restart. The legacy receipt remains unchanged.
actions_performed: Installed an Ubuntu 16.04/Python 2-compatible receiver on node1.
Created and enabled http-upload-size-boundary.service on TCP 8080.
Verified exact byte preservation, unique receipt files, size enforcement, 404 handling, and interrupted-request cleanup.
Restarted node1 and node2 serially and verified changed boot identities and recovery.
Confirmed both nodes remain Ubuntu 16.04 with kernel 4.4.0-210-generic.

evidence.requirement: Accept raw bodies up to 65536 bytes with identical stored bytes
evidence.summary: Post-restart 65,536-byte upload returned 201; source and receipt SHA-256 both equal de2f2560…9cc31.

evidence.requirement: Reject larger bodies with HTTP 413 before publishing a receipt
evidence.summary: A 65,537-byte request returned 413. Only the accepted boundary request increased the receipt count, and no temporary file remained.

evidence.requirement: Store each accepted upload in a separate receipt
evidence.summary: Separate accepted requests returned distinct receipt names with matching source and stored digests.

evidence.requirement: Interrupted requests leave no completed receipt
evidence.summary: Truncated requests declared larger bodies than transmitted; completed counts did not increase and temporary-file count remained zero.
Unrelated GET and POST paths returned 404, including after both restarts.
prior.bin retained SHA-256 ac9690aa…65fe before and after repair and restarts.
Healthy baseline captured; restart acknowledged; boot ID changed from 35c87e… to 8fbfa6…. Service, listener, HTTP response, and all receipt digests recovered.
Healthy client baseline captured; restart acknowledged; boot ID changed from dbb469… to 72f8dc…. System state and client access to node1 recovered.
Both nodes remain on Ubuntu 16.04 and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic.
